title: Release train weekly prep notes - 2026-03-01
content:
Context:
- Weekly sync to validate readiness for next release window (target launch: 2026-03-04).
- Goal: clear go/no-go list, surface blockers, confirm owners & action items.
- Quick note: still drafting canary gating thresholds — need metrics from observability team before finalizing.

Attendees (prep): Priya (owner), Alex, Jamie, Lena, Samir, Will (oncall), Maya (SRE), Heather (product ops) - confirm final list during sync.

Agenda (20–30 min):
1) Quick status (each subteam, 60s)
2) Go/No-Go checklist walkthrough (owners call out blockers)
3) Open risks and mitigation plan
4) Action items + owners + due times
5) Decision: go/no-go and roll-out cadence

Pre-reads / artifacts to have ready:
- RT Launch checklist (Confluence: RT-Launch-Checklist-2026)
- Final smoke-test plan (GITHUB:repo/release-primer#234)
- Capacity runbook + expected QPS (JIRA:RT-1234)
- Customer comms draft (product ops doc)

Go / No-Go checklist (walk thru, mark status & blockers):
- [ ] Build artifacts uploaded and tagged (owner: Alex) — STATUS: done
- [ ] E2E smoke tests defined and passing in staging (owner: Jamie) — STATUS: failing (2 flaky tests)
    - Blocker: flaky long-prompt test (investigating cause).
    - Mitigation: run 3 extra smoke runs and temp exclude the flaky case if still failing, but must be documented.
- [ ] Infra capacity validated for peak QPS with conservative buffer (owner: Maya/Sam) — STATUS: in_progress
    - Blocker: one Dedicated pool has low GPU headroom; ops to confirm burst policy.
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards + alert rules in place (owner: Lena) — STATUS: almost
    - Need one more metric: KV cache hit rate per model variant.
- [ ] Rollout runbook and rollback steps documented (owner: Priya) — STATUS: draft
    - Missing: clear circuit-breaker thresholds for auto-fallback.
- [ ] CS runbook & escalation matrix (owner: Heather) — STATUS: done
- [ ] Legal / Compliance signoff (owner: Samir) — STATUS: done for hosted; private deployment docs pending for enterprise customers
- [ ] Customer communications scheduled (owner: Product Ops) — STATUS: draft

Quick risk register (top 3):
- Risk A: Flaky smoke test could mask regression — Probable / Medium impact. Contingency: remove flaky case and run focused regression with dev. Owner: Jamie.
- Risk B: Dedicated pool GPU headroom insufficient under load — Probable / High impact. Contingency: enable burst capacity + route low-priority traffic to backup region. Owner: Maya.
- Risk C: Missing KV cache metric -> slower detection of perf regressions — Possible / Medium. Contingency: add temporary metric export from runtime. Owner: Lena.

Action items (who, what, by when):
- Jamie: triage flaky long-prompt smoke test, create ticket w/ root-cause next steps; due 2026-03-01 16:00 PST.
- Maya & Sam: confirm Dedicated pool burst policy and update capacity doc; due 2026-03-01 18:00 PST.
- Lena: add KV cache hit rate metric to staging dashboards and test alert; due 2026-03-01 17:00 PST.
- Priya: finalize rollout runbook with circuit-breaker thresholds and share link; due 2026-03-01 EOD.
- Alex: confirm build tags and produce SHA list for release notes; due 2026-03-01 15:00 PST.
- Heather/Product Ops: finalize customer comms and send to review; due 2026-03-02 10:00 PST.
- Samir: finalize private deployment compliance checklist for enterprise customers (note: not blocker for hosted launch); due 2026-03-03.

Notes to self / things to bring up in sync:
- Need explicit decision on canary percentage (default propose 5% -> 25% over 12h). If infra headroom concern persists, propose 1% -> 10% ramp.
- Ask SRE about automated fallback latency budget (what triggers model variant fallback?).
- Confirm who owns post-launch smoke runs (suggest: oncall + release eng pairing for first 2 hours).
- Ask Product about top 5 customers to watch who should be notified pre-launch.

Decision expected at meeting:
- Binary: GO if all critical blocker items resolved or have documented mitigation + owner and timeline; otherwise NO-GO.
- If GO: approve canary cadence and owners for monitoring & rapid rollback.

Follow-up / retrospective plan (post-launch):
- 24h retrospective doc template (owner: Priya) — collect logs, alert hits, customer issues.
- 7-day performance review meeting (owners: Observability + Release Eng).

Misc scratchpad (items to tidy after meeting):
- Pull together one-pager of decisions for execs (short bulleted list).
- Update Confluence checklist with final statuses and links to tickets.

---
Quick log (prep notes):
- 2026-02-25: Kicked off checklist review.
- 2026-02-27: Observability added new dashboard draft (needs KV metric).
- 2026-02-28: Smoke run showed 2 fails (long-prompt flaky + tokenization edge-case).
- 2026-03-01: Triage scheduled before sync; hope to clear long-prompt by 16:00.

Open questions for meeting:
- If smoke test still flaky at sync, do we accept documented mitigation or push window? (bring final recommendation)
- Are we comfortable with proposed canary ramp if Dedicated pool only has 10% headroom?

If anything lands late in the day, I'll update this doc and ping the group on Slack (#release-train).

Priya
